items.title: Pointwise characterizations of geometric normality by purely inseparable base change and by the local ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a scheme X over k and a point x, the lemma proves the equivalence of geometric normality at x, normality of the local rings at all points above x after every finite purely inseparable base change, and geometric normality of the local ring O_{X,x} over k (statement lines 2117-2132). The proof mirrors the geometric regularity case: from the second condition the author observes that the spectrum of O_{X,x} tensor_k k' agrees with that of O_{X,x} for a finite purely inseparable extension, so the tensor product is local and is the local ring at the unique point above x, which normality of that ring plus the algebra characterization turns into geometric normality of the local ring (proof lines 2135-2146). In the other direction an arbitrary field extension is handled by surjectivity of the base change, which produces a point x' above x whose local ring is a localization of O_{X,x} tensor_k k', hence normal by assumption (proof lines 2149-2156). The claim is H2: the uniqueness of the lifted point under a purely inseparable extension is the key input, and the two directions are otherwise short.
